findings.issue: Loops whose condition is a conjunction print as 'while flag:' with the flag computed before the loop and recomputed in the body from the value the variable will take next (x / 2, Mask(255, 1, t)), so the condition is unreadable; single-test loops of the same contract print well ('while t:').
findings.rule: If the only use of a variable c is the loop condition, and the body ends with c = f(e) followed by x = e (e not reading c), with c = f(x0) before the loop, then c == f(x) at every test: print 'while f(x):' and drop c. Mask(n, 1, x) / 2 == Mask(n, 0, x / 2) and Mask(255, 1, t) != 0 iff t / 2 != 0 make f(e) visibly f applied to e.

notes: Long functions (liquidate ~1,100 lines, borrowAtMaturity, lock ~760) reviewed by structure. Source loops (7), all whiles: OZ Strings.toHexString for (in every onlyRole revert, 'while idx > 1', ~20 copies), MarketBase.totalAssets for (1020 and ~45 inlined copies, condition readable with 28 * 24 * 3600), Market.previewDebt while (1237, 1693), Market.clearBadDebt while (2813), FixedLib.clearMaturity while (flag form, 6 copies), Market.liquidate while (flag form, 6661), VerifiedMarket.lock while (6083). Custom errors and FixedEarningsUpdate print as raw selectors/topics because the signature database lacks them (not a finding). P9: unchecked or checked products are distributed inside overflow checks ('(block.timestamp * penaltyRate - s * penaltyRate) / SafeMath.sub(block.timestamp, s)', mulDivUp as '(xy - 1) / d * bool(xy) + bool(xy)'). P8: the delegatecall functions keep the dead copy of calldata to memory. The pack's reach list includes Auditor and RewardsController functions that are external calls, not code of this bytecode; their loops are not counted.
summary: Good quality: all seven source loops are whiles and storage, events and errors match; the main defects are conjunction loop conditions printed as precomputed flags, field names invented for shifted members, and distributed multiplications in overflow checks.
